(5) Adjacent requirements are NOT claimed: ARK-REQ-0216 (Phase 2), 0218 (Phase 25), 0235 and 0319 (Phase 30), and 0364 (Phase 35) are outside this denominator. (6) THE ACCEPTANCE GUARD HAS NO PER-EVIDENCE-CONTENT GRANULARITY, proven mechanically rather than assumed: of 21 injected defective candidates, 17 were refused for their intended reason and three were ACCEPTED and are reported as accepted - a claim whose evidence prose describes a live provider run, and ARK-REQ-0219's claim with either its prov or its sec half removed, all pass check C6, because C6's contract requires a SATISFIED claim to NAME an implementation and an evidence source and cannot judge what the string says. This is the pre-existing limitation already recorded against Phase 6 (case D2) and is not introduced here; no control was added, because a repository-wide rule about evidence-string content would fail every accepted phase. The protection that does hold for this requirement is the DECLARED classification, which is structural: G08, G09, G11, G12 and G13 were each refused. A fourth case, SIMULATED_TEST_ONLY on a recorded run, was accepted and that is CORRECT rather than a gap - D-023 requires a test-only double to be permitted, and it claims nothing external.
